Description: Activated B-cell immediate-response state. CD69/CD83 mark activation, MYC supports activation-associated growth, and NFKBIA/TNFAIP3 report NF-κB induction and feedback.
Mature migratory DC state. CCR7 supports lymphatic migration, while LAMP3, FSCN1, CD83 and CD86 mark maturation, cytoskeletal remodeling and costimulation.
T-cell adhesion and trafficking state. CRTAM, ITGA4, CADM1 and CD6 support cell-cell or matrix interactions, with ADGRE5 and TSPAN5 contributing to positioning and migration.

Broad activated myeloid/DC adhesion and stromal-interaction program involving integrins, plexins, cadherin/catenin components, cytoskeletal regulators and tissue-adaptation transcription factors. Functional state, not lineage identity.
Age-associated/atypical memory B-cell program. TBX21, ITGAX and FCRL5 typify T-bet+ CD11c+ atypical B cells seen in chronic inflammation and autoimmunity. IGHG1 indicates class switching.
cDC1-linked cross-presentation program. CLEC9A/XCR1 identify cross-presenting DCs, BATF3/IRF8 drive cDC1 differentiation, and TAP1/TAP2 support MHC-I peptide loading.
Autophagy-lysosome machinery. ATG5/7/12/16L1, BECN1 and UVRAG support autophagosome formation, LC3/GABARAP and SQSTM1/NBR1 cargo handling, and LAMP2/CTSB/CTSD lysosomal degradation.
Core mature B-cell identity and BCR-support program. CD79A, CD19, CD22 and MS4A1 are canonical B-cell markers, PAX5 maintains B-cell fate, and IGHM/TNFRSF13C support mature B-cell biology.
C1Q-producing macrophage program defined by C1QA, C1QB and C1QC, characteristic of differentiated tissue macrophage and C1QC+ macrophage states.

Activated tissue-adapted CD39+ IL-18-responsive T-cell program. ENTPD1 marks chronic/tissue activation, IL18R1/IL18RAP confer IL-18 responsiveness, and RORA/CCR6/OX40/GITR indicate activated helper/regulatory-like differentiation.
Pan-T-cell/TCR complex identity. CD3D/E/G and CD247 encode TCR signaling components, while TRAC and TRBC1/2 encode αβ TCR constant regions.
CD4 helper/memory T-cell identity. CD4 marks helper T cells, while IL7R, LTB and MAL are enriched in resting or memory-like CD4 populations.
CD8 cytotoxic-lineage program. CD8A marks CD8 T cells, while NKG7, CTSW and PRF1 represent cytotoxic machinery in differentiated CD8 populations.
Conventional type 1 DC identity. CLEC9A/XCR1 are highly specific cDC1 markers, BATF3/IRF8 drive cDC1 development, and CADM1 is enriched in cDC1 populations.
Conventional type 2 DC identity. CD1C, FCER1A and CLEC10A are canonical human cDC2 markers, with CST3, CD74, IFI30 and CIITA supporting antigen processing and MHC-II presentation.
DC3-like conventional DC program. CD1C/FCER1A/CLEC10A retain cDC2-like identity, while FCGR3A, LST1 and CD163 add monocyte-associated features characteristic of DC3 states.
Inflammatory cytotoxic chemokine and IFN-γ effector program. CCL3/4/5, XCL1/2 and IFNG are produced by activated cytotoxic T/NK-like cells and recruit immune cells.
Immunoglobulin class-switch recombination and switched-isotype program. AICDA initiates switch lesions, UNG/MSH2/MSH6 process mismatches, and IGHG1/IGHA1 indicate IgG/IgA-switched cells.

Mitotic/cell-division program enriched for chromosome segregation, centrosome and cytokinesis genes including CENPE, KNL1, CEP152 and KIF20B, with HELLS/MCM9 supporting cycling chromatin and replication.
Canonical lymphocyte cytotoxicity program. NKG7, GNLY, PRF1, GZMB/GZMH and CTSW encode granule-mediated killing, while KLRD1 and FGFBP2 mark mature cytotoxic NK/CD8 states.
Early chronic-stimulation/dysfunction program. PDCD1, TOX, BATF, IRF4 and NR4A1/2/3 are induced by persistent TCR signaling and participate in establishing exhaustion before terminal differentiation.

Extracellular-matrix interaction, remodeling and migration. FN1/THBS1 provide matrix cues, ITGA5/ITGAV mediate adhesion, ADAM17/ADAMTS2 remodel extracellular proteins, and PLXND1/LRP1/ABCA1 support motility/tissue adaptation.
Recent T-cell activation/costimulation. IL2RA, CD69, TNFRSF9 and ICOS rise after receptor stimulation and mark activated effector or regulatory T-cell states.

Endocytosis, vesicle trafficking and recycling. LRP1/SCARB1/SCARB2/FCGRT mediate cargo uptake, CLTC/DNM2/AP2/PICALM support coated vesicles, and RAB5A/RAB7A/RAB11A regulate endosomal maturation/recycling.
Germinal-center dark-zone B-cell program. AICDA supports hypermutation, MKI67/PCNA rapid proliferation, CXCR4 dark-zone localization, and FOXO1 dark-zone organization.
Germinal-center light-zone selection/activation. CD83/CD86 distinguish light-zone GC B cells, CD40 reflects T-cell help, and MYC marks positively selected GC B cells.
Tissue-resident/adapted T-cell program centered on HOBIT/ZNF683. CXCR6, ITGAE and CD69 support retention, PRDM1 resident differentiation, and IFNG/XCL1/XCL2/CCL5 local effector activity.
Interferon-high DC state. IFIT1/3, ISG15 and MX1 are canonical interferon-stimulated genes, with IRF7 and STAT1 as major type I IFN regulators.
Interferon-responsive B-cell state defined by STAT1/IRF7 signaling and canonical IFN-stimulated genes IFIT3, ISG15 and MX1.
Interferon-stimulated lymphocyte state. LTB provides lymphocyte context, while ISG15, IFIT1/3, MX1 and STAT1 report an interferon response.
Broad canonical interferon-stimulated program. IFIT/IFITM, ISG15, MX, OAS, RSAD2, IFI44-family, GBP and DDX60-family genes are induced downstream of interferon/JAK-STAT signaling.

Inflammatory myeloid/inflammasome effector program. NLRP3, PYCARD and CASP1 form canonical inflammasome machinery, IL1B/CXCL8/TNF are outputs, and S100A8/A9/A12, TREM1 and CLEC4E indicate strong innate activation.
Rapid stimulus-response program. FOS, JUN, EGR1, NR4A1, IER2/3 and ATF3 are immediate-early responders, while DUSP1 provides MAPK feedback.
Inflammatory CD1c-lineage/DC3-like state with monocyte-associated features. CD14, LST1, S100A8/A9 and FCGR3A have been reported in inflammatory CD14+ DC3 populations.
Inflammatory monocyte program. S100A8/A9/A12, LYZ, LST1, FCER1G and TYROBP mark myeloid identity, while FPR1, CLEC4E, CEBPB/CEBPD and LILR genes support inflammatory innate activation.
T cells with innate/cytotoxic NK-like transcription. TCR genes confirm T-cell lineage, while NKG7, KLRD1, GNLY, PRF1 and GZMK indicate NK-like cytotoxic differentiation.
Innate pattern-recognition and feedback regulation. CLEC7A signals through SYK, NOD2 through RIPK2, TREM1 amplifies myeloid inflammation, and IRAK3/TNFAIP3 provide inhibitory feedback.
Mature LAMP3+ migratory/regulatory DC program. LAMP3, CCR7, FSCN1, CD83 and CD86 mark maturation/migration, CCL19/CCL22 recruit lymphocytes, and IFI30/B2M support antigen processing.
Lipid-uptake and lipid-processing myeloid/DC state. LPL and CD36 mediate lipid acquisition, APOE lipid transport, and FABP5 intracellular fatty-acid handling. Functional state, not lineage identity.
MAIT/MAIT-like T-cell program. TRAV1-2 is characteristic of human MAIT TCRs, KLRB1, IL18RAP, CCR6, ZBTB16 and RORA support innate-like MAIT biology, and NKG7 reports cytotoxic differentiation.
Memory B-cell program. CD27 is a classic human memory marker, TNFRSF13B supports memory/plasma-lineage survival, BANK1/CD80 mature B-cell activation, and IGHG1/IGHA1 class-switched memory.

Immune metabolic adaptation involving sterol handling and glycolytic/hypoxic responses. LDLR, ABCG1 and OSBPL genes regulate lipid transport, while PFKFB3, HIF1A and NDRG1 report glycolytic/low-oxygen adaptation.
Antigen processing/presentation. CD74, CIITA, IFI30 and FCER1A support MHC-II presentation, while TAP1/TAP2 and B2M add class-I processing capacity. CST3 is common in professional APCs.
Naive mature B-cell program. IGHD/IGHM identify unswitched BCRs, TCL1A is enriched in naive/transitional cells, FCER2/CR2 mark mature naive B cells, and MS4A1/CD19 confirm B-cell identity.
Naive or central-memory T-cell program. TCF7/LEF1/ID3 support less-differentiated states, CCR7/IL7R homing and survival, and LTB/MAL/BCL2/TXNIP resting memory-like biology.
NF-κB-activated DC state. REL/RELB indicate NF-κB-family activity, NFKBIA/TNFAIP3 are inducible NF-κB feedback genes, and CD83 marks activated/mature DCs.
NF-κB and stress-response negative feedback. NFKBIA/TNFAIP3 restrain NF-κB, BCL3/NFKBIZ modulate NF-κB transcription, and DUSP1/IER3/ATF3 limit MAPK/inflammatory responses.
Core plasmacytoid DC identity. IL3RA, CLEC4C, TCF4 and SPIB define pDC lineage/differentiation, with IRF7 and GZMB reflecting characteristic pDC functional biology.
Plasmacytoid DC interferon-producing program. IL3RA/CLEC4C identify pDCs, TCF4 maintains lineage, IRF7 supports rapid type I IFN production, and GZMB is characteristic in resting human pDCs.

Plasmablast/plasma-cell differentiation and secretory program. PRDM1 drives plasma-cell fate, XBP1 expands secretory machinery, MZB1 supports immunoglobulin secretion, and JCHAIN marks antibody-secreting cells.
General proliferating-cell program spanning DNA replication and mitosis. MKI67, TOP2A, STMN1, TUBA1B and CENPF mark cycling cells, while TYMS, PCNA and MCM5 support DNA synthesis.
IL-10-associated regulatory B-cell program. IL10 is the key suppressive cytokine, while CD24hi CD38hi phenotypes enrich human Breg populations. TNFRSF13C supports B-cell survival.
S-phase DNA-replication program. MCM5/MCM6 license replication, PCNA supports processivity, TYMS/RRM2 provide nucleotide synthesis, and DNMT1 maintains DNA methylation during replication.

TCR-linked activation with NF-κB/TNF signaling. CD247/FYN participate in proximal TCR signaling, TRAF1/3/5 and PELI1 regulate downstream pathways, and TNF/TNFAIP3 indicate inflammatory signaling plus feedback.
Terminal/exhausted T-cell program. HAVCR2, LAG3, ENTPD1 and CTLA4 encode inhibitory receptors associated with advanced exhaustion, while PRDM1 and EOMES contribute to terminal differentiation.
Type 1 helper/effector T-cell program. TBX21 is the lineage-defining Th1 factor, IFNG the signature cytokine, CXCR3 supports Th1 trafficking, and GZMK marks activated effector-memory differentiation.
Canonical Th2 program. GATA3 is the central Th2 lineage transcription factor and IL4, IL5 and IL13 are signature type 2 cytokines.
Differentiated tissue-resident/homeostatic macrophage program. MERTK, MRC1, MSR1, VSIG4, MARCO and CD163 mark scavenging/tissue adaptation, while APOE/LPL/TREM2 support lipid handling.
Tolerogenic/immunoregulatory DC state. IL10, IDO1, PDCD1LG2 and LGALS1 mediate suppression, metabolic restraint of T cells and peripheral tolerance.

Stem-like/progenitor exhausted T-cell program. TCF7/LEF1, SLAMF6, CXCR5, BCL2, BACH2 and ID3 define less-differentiated self-renewing exhausted precursors, with IL7R/LTB/MAL supporting memory-like persistence.
Peripheral helper T-cell B-cell-help program. CXCL13, PDCD1, ICOS, MAF and IL21 are central Tph features, while TOX, TIGIT, LAG3 and CTLA4 reflect chronic activation in inflamed tissues.
Regulatory T-cell program. FOXP3 is lineage-defining, IL2RA/CTLA4 are core Treg genes, IKZF2 supports stability, and TIGIT, TNFRSF18 and ENTPD1 mark activated/suppressive Treg subsets.
